title: What to expect, and what it costs
intro: No surprises. Here is how the money side works, step by step.

assessment.heading: The assessment is free
assessment.body: Answering the assessment and seeing your recommended solution costs nothing. You don't need an account or a payment method to get your match.

review.heading: The medical review
review.body: If your result goes to a doctor for review, any fee for that review is shown to you first. You confirm it before anything is charged, never automatically.

solution.heading: Your solution
solution.body: You only pay for the solution itself, and only once a prescription is issued. The price per gram is shown on every solution page and in your cart before you order.

delivery.heading: Delivery
delivery.body: Delivery from the pharmacy is included. There is no separate shipping fee. Once dispatched, orders placed before 12:00 typically arrive the next day; after 12:00, within two days.

reimbursement.heading: Private insurance and reimbursement
reimbursement.body: If you have private health insurance or want to claim a cost back, we can issue an itemised invoice after your prescription. Whether a cost is reimbursed is decided by your insurer, not by WeCare.

paying.heading: Paying
paying.body: You can pay by invoice or bank transfer. Payment is only ever taken after a doctor has approved your prescription.

disclaimer: Exact fees depend on the medical review and are always shown before they apply. This page explains the process, not a fixed price.
